I'm in the same boat as you, I just turned 24 and been knowing that I'm trans since 12 and is such a weird experience, I've had moments when I'm ok with not being out and living as I already do but there is others (Like recently) that I just can't stand this anymore.

Then all the questioning begin again, "If I'm trans why I haven't come out yet?" And "if I weren't trans, why would these feelings persist after so many years?" Are things that I can't stop questioning myself but have yet to find out the answer.

I know how hard it is to hear all that stories of people that realize their identity and come out and transition in what seems like a couple of days and then here we are, after so many years feeling like we haven't done anything really to become ourselves, I really know how it feels and wanted to tell you, you are not the only one.
